faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: Maple & Thyme Bistro is open Monday to Thursday from 11:30 AM to 10:00 PM, Friday to Saturday from 11:30 AM to 11:00 PM, and Sunday from 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do I need a reservation?
faqs.answer: Walk-ins are welcome, but reservations are recommended for dinner service and weekends. I can help you start a reservation request.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We are located at 214 Cedar Avenue, downtown. There is street parking nearby and a public lot across the block.

faqs.question: Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our menu includes several vegetarian dishes and a rotating vegan special. The kitchen can also adjust some entrees for dietary preferences.

faqs.question: Do you offer gluten-free dishes?
faqs.answer: We do offer gluten-free options and our staff can guide you through cross-contact considerations before you order.

faqs.question: Do you have a kids menu?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have a kids menu available every day and high chairs on request.

faqs.question: Do you offer catering?
faqs.answer: Yes. We cater office lunches, private parties, and small events. If you share your contact details, our team can send package options.

faqs.question: Do you host private dining events?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can host private dinners for up to 30 guests depending on the date and service window.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: There is paid street parking outside the restaurant and a public lot within a two-minute walk.

faqs.question: Can I see the menu?
faqs.answer: Our menu highlights seasonal comfort food, flatbreads, grain bowls, seafood specials, desserts, and a curated drinks list. For the latest menu, ask our team when you visit or request a callback.

faqs.question: Do you deliver?
faqs.answer: We currently offer takeout pickup, but not in-house delivery. Call ahead for pickup timing on busy evenings.

faqs.question: How can I contact the restaurant?
faqs.answer: You can leave your contact details here and our team will get back to you, or visit us during service hours at Maple & Thyme Bistro.
